name: Octavia's Bible Study
source:
Welcome to Octavia's Bible Study. You are going to meet a group of four girls who each have their own story to tell. Help them face trials of addiction, loss, redemption, and acceptance. As you are helping your friends, you will get to talk to the creator of the entire universe.

[From [url=https://axolotl-productions777.itch.io/octavias-bible-study]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到奥克塔维娅的查经班。你将在这里结识四位各有故事的女孩，帮助她们面对成瘾、失落、救赎与接纳的考验。在帮助朋友的过程中，你还将有机会与整个宇宙的造物主对话。

[引自[url=https://axolotl-productions777.itch.io/octavias-bible-study]Itch.io[/url]]
